items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses the musical composition and arrangement of 'Old Man Mose' and mentions Louis Russell's recording, but does not describe a personal relationship with the person/entity 'Old Man Mose'.

ctx.x: Okay, now, it differs in this way -- in this respect. The verse of 'Old Man Mose' started on the fifth of the chord. It was a minor chord.
